_comment: Versioned, repository-owned PROMOTE_SCOPE first-promotion bootstrap-authorization manifest. See native_short_promotion_bootstrap_evidence_v1.py for the full contract and docs/ops/native_short_sol_bootstrap_promotion_approval_v1.md for the reviewed human approval this manifest records. Authorizes exactly one PROMOTE_SCOPE for the SOL scope below, and only for a scope that has never before had any administration-ledger row (structurally single-use -- see native_short_scope_administration_transaction_v1._bootstrap_promotion_evidence_applies). It cannot be reused for ETH, XRP, BTC, or any other scope, and it cannot authorize a second promotion of SOL once the first succeeds. approved_implementation_commit names an already-existing, ordinary historical commit that introduced the reviewed bootstrap mechanism; it is verified as an ancestor of the current checkout (never compared for exact HEAD equality -- that remains the unmodified job of the existing repository-source-identity and writer-capability-authorization boundaries). approval_evidence_digest binds accepted+scope+approval_reference+approved_at_utc+approved_implementation_commit+the current SHA-256 of native_short_promotion_bootstrap_evidence_v1.py together; editing any of those fields, or the evidence module itself, without recomputing this digest fails every evaluation closed.
